open.speaker: cd_pub_landlord
lines: cd_pub_landlord
Kitchen's shut, the gale's had the gas, and the mild's on. That's the whole menu. Dennis Woolf, and this is the Culver Haven, and you've found it, which is the hard part.
cd_pub_landlord
If you're after the Levels, you want Alf, and Alf's not in till the light goes. If you're after me, I only know what gets said at the bar.
teddy
Two glasses out on the bar before we'd got through the door. He wanted company tonight.

passives.line: The photo behind the bar has a pin hole at every corner, and then four more. It's been taken down and put back more times than it's been dusted.
He says 'what gets said at the bar' like a man who's been the bar for thirty years. He's got the lot. He's deciding if you're a regular.

options.text: Two milds, then, and whatever you're having. We're not in a hurry.
We'll have what gets said at the bar. All of it.
(Sit at the bar. Say nothing. Let the gale do the talking.)

cold.speaker: cd_pub_landlord
lines: cd_pub_landlord
You'll have what I pour, and I pour slow when I'm spoken to like that. Gale's got the gas, it hasn't got my manners.
miriam
We came in out of a force eight and opened with a demand. He's right.

quiet.speaker: cd_pub_landlord
lines: cd_pub_landlord
...Windows have done that since 1906. Army built the place for the gun crews and never put a window in square.
cd_pub_landlord
All right. You can sit. People who can sit through that are people I'll talk to.

hub.speaker: cd_pub_landlord
lines: cd_pub_landlord
Thirty-one years behind this bar. Took it on in '63. Everything that's happened on this point since has been said to me first and the police second, if at all.
hub.prompt: Dennis wipes a glass that's already dry.

options.text: That photo comes down a lot. Who takes it down?

fail.line: It's a photo. It comes down to be dusted. I'll dust it now if you like.

options.text: Len Varley paid off a summer's tab in cash in one week. Where does a camp compere get that?
The cone hat at New Year '74. That's Len's hat, and it isn't Len wearing it. Who put it on?
Pour yourself one, Dennis. The gale's not going anywhere and neither are we.

static.line: The photo's watching you from behind the bar. Make him take it down himself. See which way he lays it.

photo_down.speaker: cd_pub_landlord
lines: cd_pub_landlord
Alf. Every time a stranger comes in he takes it off the wall and puts it under the dartboard, face down, and I put it back when he's gone home.
cd_pub_landlord
Twenty years. Never says why. Puts it face down like he's putting a cat out. I've stopped asking and started keeping pins in.
ruth
Face down, dear. You don't put a photograph face down because you don't like it. You do it so it can't see you.

cash.speaker: cd_pub_landlord
lines: cd_pub_landlord
He said somebody at the camp paid him to stop doing a turn. Paid him well, and told him to go home to Portsmouth and forget the island.
cd_pub_landlord
He was laughing when he said it and he wasn't laughing when he finished. Then he asked me if I'd seen a man in a yellow coat come in. I hadn't.
teddy
Paid to stop. Not sacked, paid. That's a camp that wanted something gone faster than a wage packet could manage.

cash_fail.speaker: cd_pub_landlord
lines: cd_pub_landlord
Where does anybody? Tips. He was a compere, people liked him. Go and ask down at Sunnyside, if there's anybody left there who was there.
miriam
He's sending us to the camp. That's not an answer. It's a direction, and it's the right one.

newyear.speaker: cd_pub_landlord
lines: cd_pub_landlord
...Alf. Alf Mew. He found the hat in the gun pit in the September, in the rain, and he brought it in and said he'd wear it for a laugh at New Year.
cd_pub_landlord
He had it on an hour. Then he took it off and went out in the car park and stood facing the Levels till I fetched him in, and he was crying, and Alf doesn't.
cd_pub_landlord
I burned the hat on the fire that night. It burned green. I've told nobody that and I'd thank you to keep it off Alf.
vera
Green. Felt and greasepaint burn yellow and black. Nothing honest burns green.

newyear_fail.speaker: cd_pub_landlord
lines: cd_pub_landlord
That's a private photo in a private bar, and you've had your mild. Alf's at that table from dusk. Ask Alf, and buy him one, and don't buy him two.
elijah
He didn't say no. He said ask Alf. He wants it out and he wants it to be somebody else's to tell.

pour.speaker: cd_pub_landlord
lines: cd_pub_landlord
...Go on, then. Haven't had one on duty since the Jubilee.
cd_pub_landlord
I'll tell you something for nothing. Nobody on this point laughed at those kiddies. Not one. It was the town did the laughing. Up here we'd seen the Levels.
ruth
There you are, dear. Everyone says the town laughed. Nobody's ever asked who didn't.
